source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check current firmware via cmd:
$ flint -d mlx5_<X> q | grep FW | grep Version: | grep -v Running | awk '{print $3}'

2. Flash firmware via specific "flint" cmd according to the device. For example:
$ flint -d mlx5_<X> -y -i <MLNX-FW>.bin -ocr b

3. Check new firmware via cmd:
$ flint -d mlx5_<X> q | grep FW | grep Version: | grep -v Running | awk '{print $3}'

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Flash firmware without errors.
2. Check that new firmware after flash should be correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Queries mlx5_0, then runs `flint -d mlx5_0 -y -i MLNX_FW.bin -ocr b` and filters post-flash output.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Pre/post firmware version lines for user confirmation.
deepseek_columns.risk: Flashing can brick the device; exact PSID-matched image required and no auto-run.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies MFT/image dependency and bricking risk, but assumes mlx5_0 and reduces evidence to filtered version lines.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds PSID/image/hash/MFT compatibility, stable identity, traffic isolation, OOB, recovery and full transcripts.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL; identifies operator-provided target/variables and static shell quoting/nested-SSH defects.

original_test_intent: Program the approved Mellanox firmware image into the intended adapter and verify that the same device reports the expected new firmware version without flash, device, link or platform errors.
original_method: Use MFT/flint to capture the current firmware, burn the designated binary with the source options, query the same device afterward, and inspect OS/BMC logs while preserving the full transaction evidence.
manual_activity: An authorized user supplies and approves the image, exact target, maintenance window, flash options and recovery/activation plan. Those readiness decisions do not make the command-driven flash and evidence collection a manual core.
required_inputs: Adapter serial/PCI BDF/MST device, model, PSID and current firmware
Exact firmware artifact, intended version, checksum/signature and adapter/PSID compatibility evidence
Approved MFT/flint version and reviewed meaning of `-y` and `-ocr` for this image/device
Traffic dependency, quiesce window, power stability and independent OOB path
Post-burn activation/reset requirement and tested recovery/rollback procedure
safety_requirements: Resolve the target by stable PCI/MST identity and PSID; never assume `mlx5_0` or first-match order.
Reject a device/image/PSID/version/digest mismatch and do not use force or PSID-changing behavior unless the exact project plan explicitly authorizes it.
Quiesce affected traffic, preserve independent management access and stable power, and verify recovery assets before writing.
Keep complete flint stdout/stderr, exit status and pre/post queries; filtered FW lines are not sufficient evidence.
Stop on any flash warning, timeout, verification error, lost device or uncertain state; do not retry, reset or roll back automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Validate artifact provenance, image metadata, target identity/PSID, tool version, traffic state, approval and recovery gates.
Capture complete pre-flash device/image queries and execute the unchanged approved flint burn against the stable target.
Capture full transcript and perform only the approved activation/reset step if one is required.
Query the same adapter, verify firmware/device/link/log health, and report Tool Result without declaring testcase PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact artifact, target, write flags, traffic window and recovery/activation procedure.
Intervene on any warning or uncertain flash state rather than allowing an automatic retry.
Review firmware, link and platform evidence and issue the formal PASS/FAIL verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The source flint workflow remains applicable, but the DeepSeek wrapper is not safe as written because it fixes mlx5_0, uses unconditional confirmation/override flags and filters away decisive output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source query/burn/query sequence, replacing placeholders only from the approved manifest and capturing unfiltered device/image and burn output.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: `flint -d mlx5_<X> q`, `flint -d mlx5_<X> -y -i <MLNX-FW>.bin -ocr b`, both 30-minute fields and all original placeholders remain recorded; this review does not silently authorize them.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the approved MFT release to query the stable MST/PCI target and image metadata, compare PSID/version/digest, then run the source flint burn only after all gates pass and retain full before/during/after evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the Mellanox/NVIDIA adapter and firmware family explicitly matched by the project image and PSID.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record the deployed MFT/flint version, adapter firmware family and image digest at execution time.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA Firmware Tools documentation (MFT v4.26.1-6 LTS) and NVIDIA Support Query and Upgrade Procedures describe flint query/burn use and retrieving PSID/current firmware from the exact MST device.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable target/image identity, PSID/digest, traffic/OOB/recovery gates and complete evidence without replacing flint or changing coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; firmware programming and post-burn version verification remain mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Exact image-to-PSID approval and recovery/activation plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A successful command exit or matching version alone does not prove the adapter, link or host recovered correctly.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different compatible image, MFT release, target path, flash options or activation method. The result must name the actual approved plan and cannot claim the source placeholder image/options were executed.
expected_evidence: Adapter identity/PSID/current firmware and full pre-flash flint query
Firmware filename, digest/signature, image metadata, compatibility approval and MFT version
Complete burn transcript, exact command/options, timestamps and exit status
Full post-flash query of the same identity plus enumeration/link/driver and OS/BMC/SEL health
Tool Result, deviations and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, procedure and criteria consistently require Mellanox firmware programming and post-flash version confirmation. Missing target/image details are project readiness inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended operation and acceptance evidence are clear. Execution must wait for exact artifacts and safeguards, but the library review is not blocked and those inputs do not make the case permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its recognition of the write risk but rejects fixed-device selection and filtered proof.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains the PSID, compatibility, traffic, OOB and recovery safeguards while correcting the classification: required package and one-user approval do not make an otherwise machine-executable core PARTIAL.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automation capability, execution readiness, Tool Result and engineer verdict and preserves the original burn method without authorizing unsafe placeholders.

review_improvement: Prevents flashing the wrong adapter or PSID image, preserves failure context, and keeps a high-risk but automatable firmware operation distinct from engineer-owned acceptance.
independent_technical_reasoning: Every core action—identity validation, flint query, firmware write, transcript capture and post-state checks—can be orchestrated after the approved plan is fixed. Human authorization and artifact supply govern readiness and safety, not whether the test core is automatable.

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat the burn, activate/reset the device, roll back or power-cycle automatically after any failure or uncertain state.
